Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
MOQ varies by product. For gabion boxes, MOQ is typically 50 pieces. For protection nets, it starts from 100 m². We can discuss flexible arrangements for new clients.
What is the typical lead time?
Standard products: 7-15 days. Custom/OEM orders: 15-30 days depending on complexity and quantity. Rush orders can be accommodated with an additional fee.
Do you provide free samples?
Yes, we offer free samples for most products. The client covers the shipping cost. Sample cost is refundable upon placing the first bulk order.
What payment terms do you accept?
We accept T/T (30% deposit, 70% before shipping), L/C at sight for large orders (above $20,000), Western Union for small amounts, and PayPal for sample fees.
Can you do custom sizes and specifications?
Absolutely! Our strength is custom manufacturing. Provide us with your drawings or specifications, and our engineering team will work out the best solution.
